reason: The report answers a firm-wide question using only the central region, a restriction with no stated basis beyond 'most comparable'. My re-run with the same controls gives a pooled estimate of -0.28 (SE 0.24), north -0.15 (null), and south -0.91 (p=0.016, significantly negative). Effects therefore differ by region, so a central-only 'no effect' conclusion is not representative or supported, and it ignores the wide CI and the south result.
